# Ledger: parcel-tracker (Vienna warehouse shipment tracking)
<!-- gemkeeper ledger. Written for the next session. Keep it under ~120 lines. Edit in place. -->
Updated: 2026-11-16

## Mission
- Feature work on parcel-tracker: Node 24 runs TS directly (no build step), zero dependencies. User works autonomously-by-default and reviews everything at the end. Nothing is committed yet (all work is uncommitted in the working tree).

## Rules
- (user) NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — the platform team's sync job overwrites the folder every Monday, so changes are silently lost.
- (user) NO new npm dependencies, not even dev deps — each package needs a ~6-week security review.
- (user) Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (warehouse staff UI shows them verbatim to packers); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Old English messages are left as they are.
- (user) GET /shipments/:id response must NOT change in any way (no added/removed/renamed fields) — mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown/missing fields; next mobile release is January. `shipmentToApi()` in src/routes/shipments.ts is shared by list, detail and POST, so extend per-endpoint, not in the shared function.
- (user) NEVER log recipient name, address or phone — anywhere, any log line (GDPR personal data; the DPO flagged it in last month's audit). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are OK to log.
- (user) Flaky test: 'emits webhook on delivered' in test/events.test.ts (OPS-412, platform team owns it). If it fails: rerun once, do NOT fix.

## Decisions
- Store perf: keep JSON file, debounce writes in src/store.ts (mutations within 200 ms => ONE write) + a flush method for shutdown — because save() rewrote the whole file per mutation and got slow at a few thousand shipments. (user)
- Austrian public holidays are a hardcoded list in src/services/holidays.ts, 2026+2027 only (list must be extended before 2028; other years silently get no holidays) — because the deployment has no outbound internet. (user)
- ATP tracking numbers are validated as UPU S10 with check digit (src/lib/s10.ts, code INVALID_TRACKING_NUMBER); all other carriers accept any non-empty value — because carrier formats change often and valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for 2 days last year. (user) The check lives in the shared validateShipmentInput, so POST /import validates ATP too.
- ERP signature is a top-level `sig` field in the JSON body (HMAC-SHA256 hex over the compact JSON without `sig`, `sig` appended as last key), enabled by env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET; unset secret => unsigned — because the ERP gateway strips X- headers; unsigned fallback keeps sandbox working during rollout ERP-1182. (user)
- ERP retries: 3 attempts total, FIXED 30 s delay, no backoff, retry on network/timeout/5xx only (not 4xx), same payload each attempt, delay injectable via createNotifier({sleep,...}) — because the ERP dedupes by event_id only within 2 minutes (worst case 75 s). (user)

## Dead ends
- fs.watch for hot-reloading config/default.json → never fires on staging: the config is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host, file change events don't propagate into the container. fs.watchFile (polling) worked. Hot reload is a future need, nothing built yet. (user)
- X-Signature header for the webhook signature → ERP API gateway strips all custom X- headers; ERP saw every request as unsigned (verified on staging). Never use headers for it. (user)
- Batching ERP events (array of up to 50 per POST) → ERP answers 422 to ANY array payload; only one event object per request. Do not build. (user)

- Moving the store to SQLite (node:sqlite) → rejected by user: ops backs up data/store.json with a nightly
